items.title: Add material-overlap audit to Authority gate request contracts
items.context: Update GateEvaluateRequestContract and schema with a typed materialOverlapAudit containing changedFiles and actualFileOverlaps. Keep the field explicit and narrow; do not add new /v1/checks or /v1/commands contracts.
items.userSees: Targeted contract regression output includes "GateEvaluateRequestContract materialOverlapAudit schema PASS changedFiles=[] actualFileOverlaps=[]" and no /v1/checks or /v1/commands contract diff is needed.

happy.desc: Parse a GateEvaluateRequestContract for targetPhase=DONE with materialOverlapAudit.changedFiles=[] and materialOverlapAudit.actualFileOverlaps=[] -> schema accepts it and the parsed request retains both arrays; WHY: proves schema acceptance for the required empty no-overlap audit shape from docs/requirements/decisions/authority-done-material-overlap-audit-cli-fix.md.

edge.desc: Parse a gate request whose materialOverlapAudit.changedFiles contains concrete repo paths while actualFileOverlaps is empty -> both arrays remain present and unchanged; WHY: changed-file evidence must not be dropped when there are no overlaps.

adversarial.desc: Submit malformed materialOverlapAudit values such as missing actualFileOverlaps or non-array changedFiles -> contract validation rejects or fails before signing; WHY: the field must stay explicit and narrow instead of becoming a loose passthrough blob.

items.title: Include material-overlap audit in signed DONE gate envelopes
items.context: Ensure buildGateEvaluateEnvelope places decision.materialOverlapAudit inside the decision payload before signHexEnvelope. The general Authority gate path must preserve non-empty actualFileOverlaps rather than clearing them.
items.userSees: Signed DONE gate envelopes include decision.materialOverlapAudit before signing, and non-empty actualFileOverlaps remain in the signed payload so Authority can fail closed instead of receiving a cleared audit.

happy.desc: Build and sign a DONE gate envelope from a request with materialOverlapAudit={changedFiles:[],actualFileOverlaps:[]} -> signed envelope decision.materialOverlapAudit exactly matches the request before signature verification; WHY: proves the Authority DONE audit is inside the signed decision payload.

edge.desc: Build a DONE gate envelope from a request with a non-empty actualFileOverlaps entry -> the signed decision preserves that overlap entry byte-for-byte instead of replacing it with []; WHY: non-empty overlaps must remain visible so Authority can reject/fail closed.

adversarial.desc: Mutate or append materialOverlapAudit only after signing -> signature verification or digest comparison fails; WHY: prevents an unsigned audit field from satisfying the DONE/enforce contract.

items.title: Update live Python E2E smoke DONE preflight
items.context: authority-live-python-e2e-smoke must submit a minimal empty materialOverlapAudit for the no-overlap staging smoke so DONE preflight no longer fails with present=false.
items.userSees: authority-live-python-e2e-smoke posts the DONE preflight to /v1/gates/evaluate with decision.materialOverlapAudit.changedFiles=[] and actualFileOverlaps=[], so staging no longer fails with materialOverlapAudit.present=false.

happy.desc: Run the no-overlap authority-live-python-e2e DONE preflight request builder -> the signed POST body for /v1/gates/evaluate includes decision.materialOverlapAudit with empty changedFiles and actualFileOverlaps arrays; WHY: proves the live smoke request shape matches the Authority DONE/enforce requirement.

edge.desc: Build the live smoke request with zero, one, or multiple evidence refs -> materialOverlapAudit stays present and empty for the no-overlap staging smoke; WHY: audit presence must not depend on unrelated evidence hash population.

adversarial.desc: Remove materialOverlapAudit from the live smoke DONE preflight body -> local request-shape assertion or staging response reports materialOverlapAudit.present=false and the smoke fails; WHY: guards against regression to the original omission.

items.title: Add regression coverage and rebuild CLI
items.context: Cover schema acceptance, envelope inclusion before signing, live smoke request shape, and preservation of non-empty overlaps. Rebuild packages/main/dist after source changes.
items.userSees: Targeted regression coverage fails if schema acceptance, signed envelope inclusion, live smoke request shape, or non-empty overlap preservation regresses, and npm --prefix packages/main run build regenerates the CLI output.

happy.desc: Run targeted regression tasks plus npm --prefix packages/main run build -> tests cover schema acceptance, signed envelope inclusion, live smoke request shape, non-empty overlap preservation, and TypeScript emits CLI output; WHY: proves the fix is guarded and buildable.

edge.desc: Regression tests exercise both empty audit arrays and a non-empty actualFileOverlaps case -> empty no-overlap smoke succeeds while non-empty overlap data remains visible for rejection; WHY: both safe acceptance and fail-closed preservation are required.

adversarial.desc: Deliberately omit materialOverlapAudit, add it after signing, or clear actualFileOverlaps in the implementation -> at least one targeted regression or the TypeScript build fails; WHY: tests must catch each known regression vector from the decision doc.

items.title: Run targeted validation and record evidence
items.context: Run the targeted tests/build and, if staging credentials are available, the Authority live smoke against https://staging.hostneutral.net. Record exact evidence and any remaining external blocker.
items.userSees: Checklist evidence records exact targeted build/test commands and either a passing Authority live smoke against https://staging.hostneutral.net or a concrete external blocker such as missing staging credentials.

happy.desc: Run npm --prefix packages/main run build and the targeted Authority smoke/regression commands, then record verificationEvidence for each covered intent -> evidence shows pass with exact commands, HEAD/material hashes where available, and lattice validate accepts coverage; WHY: build/test/live smoke evidence must prove the DONE path is repaired.

edge.desc: If staging credentials or network access for https://staging.hostneutral.net are unavailable -> record the attempted live smoke command and a classified external blocker while still recording local build/regression passes; WHY: external unavailability must be explicit and must not pretend the live smoke passed.

adversarial.desc: Attempt to advance validation with missing, stale, or text-only evidence for the schema/envelope/live-smoke/build intents -> lattice validate or story review rejects the coverage as incomplete; WHY: prevents DONE without concrete evidence for the Authority material overlap audit fix.
